clips.send: Zhuge Liang’s Hut, Nanyang. Zhuge Liang farmed here before 207 Today: Wolonggang, Nanyang, Henan Zhuge Liang lived in a thatched hut until Liu Bei came three times to ask for his help. Both Nanyang (Henan) and Longzhong near Xiangyang (Hubei) claim the hut.

clips.send: Old Drunkard’s Pavilion. Built by the monk Zhixian; named by Ouyang Xiu, 1046 Today: Mount Langya, Chuzhou, Anhui The monk Zhixian built it and Ouyang Xiu named it after himself. With its wing-like roof corners (翼然) it is one of China’s four famous pavilions.

clips.send: Jinan. Capital of Shandong, the “City of Springs” Jinan has more than 70 famous springs; the water of Baotu Spring bubbles up all year round.
